arguments.summary: Decision: develop differentiated 21/63-session research theses for ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA, testing company catalysts against shared macro, technical and policy risks; do not force a ranking or forecast. Grouped Company, Macro, Technical and Geopolitics assignments have been accepted. Commodities is omitted because no commodity-specific transmission channel is established in the registered source catalog within the shared budget; any material semiconductor-input or energy channel remains a review gap.

claims.text: The eventual assessment will distinguish idiosyncratic catalysts from common AI/megacap, rates/liquidity, and policy-risk channels over 21/63 sessions rather than assuming diversification across the watchlist.
Research assignments were accepted for Company (including QQQ dated look-through), Macro, Technical, and Geopolitics coverage across the entire watchlist.

gaps.description: No research findings have yet been returned from the accepted Company, Macro, Technical, or Geopolitics assignments; instrument-level assessment is therefore not currently supportable.

Commodities coverage was omitted to preserve shared budget because the registered catalog does not establish a direct commodity channel. This leaves potential input-cost/energy transmission unassessed.

assumptions: The relevant decision horizon is 21 and 63 sessions.
QQQ must be assessed using dated sponsor profile/holdings rather than synthetic corporate earnings.
Fixed SPY, XLK/XLC, IWM and HYG observations will be treated as contextual comparators, not evidence of portfolio breadth.
Commodities research is not proportionate to currently registered evidence or shared-budget constraints.
arguments.counter_thesis: Near-term price behavior may be dominated by a common growth-duration and AI-capex factor, making company-specific differences and QQQ diversification less meaningful than the research plan presumes.

review_conditions.description: Reassess once the four accepted specialist findings are available, including their source-supported company, macro, technical and policy evidence.

shared_exposures.mechanism: Candidate common exposure to growth-duration valuation, AI-related capital-spending expectations, and policy shocks; QQQ may provide look-through overlap rather than independent exposure.
shared_exposures.qualification: Planning hypothesis only. Company facts, dated QQQ weights, and macro/policy transmission have been assigned but not yet verified.
